description: Searches the signed-in member's own Pine Script® scripts on LuxAlgo: the ones Quant wrote for them in a chat (`origin: quant`) and the ones they saved from the code editor (`origin: user`). Each result has its id, name, kind (indicator, strategy or library), origin, a one-line description when there is one, and when it was created and last saved; newest first. `query` matches names and descriptions; leave it out for the latest scripts. Results carry no source: fetch one script's code with get_user_script and its id. For LuxAlgo's published indicators use library_search, not this. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

origin.description: Only scripts Quant wrote, or only the member's own.

query.description: Words to look for in script names and descriptions.

name: quant_search_user_scripts
title: Search my scripts
